title: Downgrade
body:
I’ve been using Forest since 2023, and I have to say I’m a bit disappointed with how it’s evolved. The latest update is laggy and messes up the timer display. 
I don’t mind the option of having a Plus account, but it’s constantly shoved in your face to the point where it becomes annoying; I’m a student, and I used to find Forest the most relaxing way to track my sessions, but I’m liking the app less and less.
author: Student and daily forest user

title: Once good, now only annoying
body: I bought this app back when it was a pay-once model. I loved it for years for its simplicity, that it does smth good in the world and cute designs. But now that picked it up again after a long break it is cluttered with subscription reminders showing you every step on the way what you miss out by not paying. They gave me a tree and terrain as compensation that I bought the app back in the day but tbh that is NOT what I want nor do I feel like this should be legal since they changed the terms of what I payed for. The app now feels too busy, less intuitive and there’s rumours that they use genAI. All in all I do not reccomend it anymore. It’s easier to light a tea light and work until it has extinguished. At least it won’t bombard me with useless stuff. And it’s cheaper too in bulk.
author: Rebecca Kilde

title: Frustrating downgrade
body: Forest has been my favorite productivity app for years, but the recent update feels like a downgrade. Adjusting the focus time has become unnecessarily complicated, when it used to be simple and intuitive. The new design also feels more childish and less polished than before, which takes away from the clean, focused experience I really liked about Forest. I hope you’ll reconsider these changes and bring back the simplicity and mature design that made the app so enjoyable to use - so I can spend less time adjusting my focus time and more time actually focusing.
author: Longtime Forest User

title: The best study tool for ADHDers!
body:
This app has been a godsend, and it’s the only app I’ve used for years consistently! I have ADHD, and studying (or just focusing in general) when my phone is around has always been such a struggle. With this app I’m able to challenge myself and leave my phone alone to grow my forest, and it gives me the dopamine boost I need when I see a new tree in my forest! 

I love the variety of trees you can plant! I’m currently saving up in-game coins to buy the doggo-tree, and I’m obsessed! 

I’ve recently started using it when being around friends and family as well, and I use it when I’m hanging out when my boyfriend to stay off my phone. It’s a great motivator to know that I’m able to stay in the moment more and be present, and get rewards for it!

If you’re like me and struggle to leave your phone alone I highly recommend this app! I’ve been recommending it to my friends, classmates, and ESPECIALLY my fellow ADHDers for years, and I can’t say it enough - this app is amazing!

I’d give it 15/10 stars if I could, but 5 will do for now. The only thing I would recommend while using the app is to turn off notifications, as it is insanely tempting to stop the stopwatch early.

title: It helped, but there's still for improvement
body:
The app helped me use my phone less as you get a visible reward from staying from your phone. For me, the interface would be better if it was simpler: easier to find friends on the app, no sections like tags or news or rooms or timeline, just focus on what you and your forest (and perhaps friends' too). Also, it'd be better if you could whitelist apps on ios and have some setting that only enables educational apps and you can still keep all your coins.

Not to forget the fact that it's a great app that helped me a lot!

author: ibstudent😭

title: My most helpful app
body:
I have a huge problem concentrating on anything at a given length of time. My mind keeps floating to other stuff, and I usually end up googling everything that comes to mind, checking to see if I’ve received any messages on my social medias, or just generally doing other things I should not do at that time on my phone.

With this app, I find I have an easier time working with what I’m supposed to. I usually set it to 25 minutes, and tell myself “now I’ll just work for 25 minutes, then have a break, and then see if I can’t work another 25 minutes afterwards”. And I can!
This was the best tool for me during exam preps and I simply cannot express how much value I’ve gotten out of it. And the fact that your points can be turned into a REAL tree?! Wow!
5/5 for a good reason!

title: I don’t know why this works so well
body: But i really does. Somehow, keeping a viritual tree alive becomes more important than every other smartphone-related activity in my life. This app made me rethink the importance of finding out whether his name is actually «Brian Emo», as opposed to the more likely «Brian Eno». My sudden urge to find out whether Crystal Pepsi™️ is still on the market is easily evaporated by a growing tree and a timer. Thanks to Forest, I’m having a midlife-crisis at the age of 22, and I’m perfectly fine with it. Better now than later. Thank you.
